Name: Baljeet
Dialog: We're going to the circus! We're going to the circus! (Cut to the kitchen, where Phineas, Ferb, Isabella and Django is eating Pow cereal... aside from Buford) I am here and ready to go to the world-famous Cirque de Lune.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have a seat. We're goin' in a minute.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ok. We're going to the circus! We're going to circus!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, hold your horses, kids. It says here that the lead of Cirque de Lune has a severe allergy. They're canceling today's performance.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, that's a bummer!

Name: Linda
Dialog: If it's anything like Candace's parsnip allergy, whew! I don't blame him for not wanting to appear in public.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (at Isabella) She gets blotchy. Red, weird voice thingy. (whispering) Not good.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, honey, looks like that frees you up to join me at the mall. Our trio is recording our first album today

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Mmm mmm, should be swinging.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Cheer up, guys. I'm sure you'll have a fun day anyway. (She and Lawrence leave the kitchen) Bye, kids, be good. Have fun!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It must be so cool to be in the circus.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah. (snaps his fingers) Hey, Ferb, let's put on our own Cirque. This'll be great! Ferb can set up the tent, I'll be the ringmaster.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We can sew up some arty costumes.

Name: Django
Dialog: Hey, for a trick, I can put my leg over my head. (Tries and falls over) Ow. I'll work on it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Even Perry can have an act! The Amazing Perry! (trumpets sound as Perry faces the camera with food in his mouth, drooling)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Ooh, I have a mystical, magical act I would like to perform. It's stupefying!

Name: Buford
Dialog: I have another act that'll bring the house down.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, get the tools!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Let's do this!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sleeping next to a framed photo of her boyfrined; yawns) Good morning, Jeremy. (fake boy voice) Good morning, gorgeous. (normal voice) Oh, Jer! (Candace giggles and rubs a framed photo of herself against the Jeremy photo, making kissing sounds. She is soon alerted to power tools whirring and thumping) I'll be right back, Jeremy. (she looks out of the window) What's going on? (Ferb has just set up the tent) A circus? Can't they give me a break for one day?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: This looks great, Ferb. (machinery hissing) Hey, have you seen Perry? I put on his costume.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (clearing his throat) Okay, Agent P. Dr. Doofenshmirtz is buying bio-mechanical equipment and... (chuckles) ...elocution tapes. (laughing) W-we don't know why. (Perry walks away) Where are you going, Agent P? Wait, wait, wait, wait. Don't-Don't go. I'm not laughing at you. I just heard a funny joke earlier this morning and- Please-please, Agent P. Turn around so we can conclude our meeting. (camera phone snaps) Carl! (3x) What's your e-mail? Gonna send this to you.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, twerp, I brought the props for my act.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Buford, what exactly is your act?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I fly into mud with a paper bag on my head.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, then.

Name: Buford
Dialog: The peeps are gonna love.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) I'm not even gonna call Mom. Nope, not gonna call! (Unfortunately, the sound of an elephant forces her hand, and she calls Linda)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (recording album at the Squat 'n' Stitch inside Googolplex Mall; answers phone) Candace, honey, listen. I can't talk. We're recording. Is it life or death?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (back home...) Well, no, but...

Name: Linda
Dialog: I gotta go! Bye! (Candace growls in frustration)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Heya, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh! Hi, Jeremy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: My mom told me to bring over these homegrown veggies for your family. You know; she and your mom are doing that jazz thing today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So, circus, huh? Cool. Cool. I guess it's more of a cirque than a "circus". (laughs)

Name: Candace (earlier)
Dialog: (in her Jeremy voice) Good morning, gorgeous.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh. (giggles)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Don't you think?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Don't you think we should sit together to watch the show? If-if you want to.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah. (hacking cough, wheezing)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, Candace, are you okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Say, are there any wild parsnips in here?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh, I think that's all that's in there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (choked gasp) Later.

Name: Man
Dialog: I'm dancing with your wife, pal. You got a problem with that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm dance... (clears throat) "I'm dancing with your wife, pal. You got a problem with that?" Oh, yes, that does sound tough.

Name: Man
Dialog: Yeah, I ate your last nectarine. You got a problem with that?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yes, I ate... (Agent P crashes in as usual; coughs) Perry the Platypus, look. Could-could you just use the front door from now on? Could you just do that for me? I mean, (Clears throat) "Yes I ate your last nectarine. You got a problem with that?" Sounds tough, huh? But not tough enough! (He pushes button on a remote and Perry gets trapped in a net) You see; ever since I was a child, I had a high, squeaky voice! But not anymore. Behold

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course, it had to be wild parsnips. Allergy pills, allergy pills. Aha! Quick! Before my voice goes through the reaction. (She finds there are no pills left. She now has in a deep, manly voice) Noooooooooooo!

Name: Mindy
Dialog: Hey, Jeremy. Wanna sit together at the show?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no! Mindy can't sit with Jeremy! Gotta stop this, gotta tell Mom! Can't go out looking like this! (The camera pans to a paper bag on the floor. Outside...)

Name: Mindy
Dialog: So, how about us sitting together?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Now wearing the paper bag and a grey jacket, she runs past them) 'Scuse me.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, it's good, bro. (at Mindy) Thanks, but I promised Candace. (Candace runs off down the street)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (from inside the cirque tent; over P.A.) We're moments away from Ferb and The Amazing Perry!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Ferb. You guys are up next. Where's Perry? (Perry, back in his cirque outfit, walks towards the boys) Oh, there you are.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And now, for my final trick, (cut to main stage) I will reattach my thumb! Feel the rhythm, feel the rhyme, come on thumb, it's healing time.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's hear it for Baljeet the Stupefying! But now, prepare to be astounded when The Amazing Semi-aquatic Perry, aided by Ferb, attempts to jump through that hoop into the Shallow Pond!

Name: Audience
Dialog: Ooh! (Ferb tosses Perry onto the trampoline and he goes through the hoop and lands in the bucket of water)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah! Let's hear it for the Amazing Semi-aquatic Perry!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Psst. Mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, have you been near the wild parsnips again?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, but you gotta see what Phineas and Ferb are doing.

Name: Linda
Dialog: What is it now?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Let me spell it out for you, Mom

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Mom, so you gonna come home with me?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Are you kidding, hon? Let's do another! (Candace groans as walks off back to home)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, but you are too late. .... (Perry attenpts to turn it off but Doof smacks his hand away) Wait! Wait, don't touch that! .... Stop it! Stop it! (Perry tickles Doofenshmirtz) Stop it, I told you! Stop it! I said, keep your hands off of that.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, I got my costume all set. Be sure to introduce me as The Amazing Baggo.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You know, we've been thinking about your act and have some suggestions. Modify your torque and reverse the angle of trajectory.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I still get to land in the mud, right?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, yeah, yeah.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I want the mud.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thank you, Django, the Human Pretzel! (Django moans) That's gotta hurt. And now, our next act will catapult through the heavens, and land in a pit filled with the mysterious Aztec mud of doom!

Name: Audience
Dialog: Ooh! hoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Candace runs in the tent) Jeremy! Jeremy! Jeremy! (gasps) He saved me a seat.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I give you The Amazing Baggo!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ta-da! Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Guys, cut it out! Let go!

Name: Buford
Dialog: That dude's stealing my act! (Ferb pulls the lever; Candace gets flung out of the tent, screaming; Ferb whoooos)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm. He must have been lighter than we calculated.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No, no! This is Buford's moment to shine! (jumps into the pit of mud) Hey, everybody, over here! (All cheer)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wait. How'd he get down there?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Perhaps Buford truly is amazing.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great, now this thing's broken. (The tube of Doofelium lowers into the hole Candace made)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And now, ladies and gentlemen, (voice-pitch rising) I give you our entire cast in our grand finale, (shift to Agent P gliding down) featuring The Amazing Perry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Voice rising) CURSE YOU, PERRY THE PLATYPUS! (the crash causes an explosion)

Name: Kid #1
Dialog: Whoa! Thanks, Phineas!

Name: Kid #2
Dialog: I thought your cirque rocked, Phineas.

Name: Kid #3
Dialog: Thanks, Phineas. You're the coolest.

Name: Boy
Dialog: That was the best circus I've ever been to.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well Phineas, awesome as usual!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi, guys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mom, Dad, you missed our cirque.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, it sure looks like you had fun. (Perry chatters) Who wants to hear my CD?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ooh, I do.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: All right, come on!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool. (They go in the house)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (crawls; moans, back to her usual voice) Oh, well, at least I'm back to normal.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace. My mom played me some of their CD. Your singing is awesome! How'd you get your voice to sound like that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, same as all the great blues singers
